brief_title: 4 Week Treatment With Three Oral Doses of BI 10773 in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of 4 Weeks Treatment With Three Oral Doses of BI 10773 as Tablets in Female and Male Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of Subjects With Drug Related Adverse Events
primary_outcomes.time_frame: from drug administration up to 6 weeks

primary_outcomes.time_frame: from drug administration up to 6 weeks

brief_summary: Primary objective: safety and tolerability of BI 10773 in male and female patients with type 2 diabetes Secondary objective: pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of BI 10773

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and postmenopausal or hysterectomised female patients with type 2 diabetes
* Age \>18 and \< 70 years
* BMI \>18.5 and \<40 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Antidiabetic treatment with insulin or glitazones or with more than one oral hypoglycaemic agent;
* Fasted blood glucose \> 240 mg/dl (\>13.3 mmol/L) or a blood glucose level above 400 mg/dl (22.2 mmol/L) postprandially;
* HbA1c \> 8.5 %
